name: JEE Main Chemistry Physical Mock Test - Subject Test 1
courseName: JEE Main Chemistry Physical Mock Test

questions.question: Which quantum number determines the spatial orientation of an orbital in an atom?
questions.hint: Magnetic quantum number (m) specifies orbital orientation in space.

questions.question: Which product is primarily formed when phenol reacts with chloroform and aqueous NaOH (Reimer-Tiemann Reaction)?
questions.hint: Reimer-Tiemann reaction converts phenol to salicylaldehyde.

questions.question: What type of isomerism is exhibited by [Co(NH3)5(SO4)]Br and [Co(NH3)5Br]SO4?
questions.hint: Ionization isomerism yields different ions in aqueous solution.
